title: Tension fabric
description: Plum and green threads hang from a pinned edge and pull against their neighbors.
useCase: Interactive woven materials, cloth studies and responsive mesh surfaces.
interaction: Drag a thread, pluck the cloth, adjust wind, or pause
reducedMotion: Continuous simulation stops. Pluck and direct manipulation produce static changes.
limitations: A bounded 2D position-constraint solver; no 3D collisions, tearing, textile texture asset, or export.
look: Dark plum field with a hanging checkered weave of olive-green and mauve threads pinned along its top edge, with outlined buttons and a slider below.
motion: A Verlet cloth pinned at its top row sags under gravity and sways in sine wind; dragging pulls the nearest thread, and the pluck button kicks the middle up-right.
adapt: The solver is `step` (Verlet integration, six constraint passes) and `draw` paints the weave; tune `cols`, `rows`, gravity `0.055`, damping `0.965` and the `wind` ref; `action` handles pluck and reset. Recolour the plum and green fills in `draw`.
